subject: Physics

objectives.name: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Apply knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Analyse, interpret and evaluate scientific information, ideas and evidence

components.name: Paper 1
components.format: 60 marks of short and long answer questions and 25 multiple choice questions

notes: Assessment objectives are set by Ofqual and are identical across every board's A-level Physics; only the weightings differ.
40% of the overall assessment contains mathematical skills at Level 2 or above.
At least 15% of the overall assessment covers practical work.
Paper 3 includes an options section; students answer on one option from sections 9-13.
